The 2026 scholarship round closed on 25 February at 13:00 CET, and the 2027 round is expected to use the same date, giving maths applicants a relatively late deadline.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

InterMaths is an Erasmus Mundus joint master in mathematical modelling and simulation with applications in biomedical sciences and industrial engineering, coordinated from the University of L'Aquila. The 2026 scholarship round closed on 25 February at 13:00 CET, and the 2027 round is expected to use the same date, giving maths applicants a relatively late deadline.

Programme Highlights

  • Applied mathematics programme with biomedical and industrial modelling tracks
  • Late-February scholarship deadline — useful for applicants still gathering documents
  • Double-degree structure across consortium universities
  • Foundation semester available to homogenise competencies before the main curriculum

Who Should Apply

Mathematics and applied mathematics graduates (physics and engineering applicants with strong maths are also considered); a short teaching or research statement forms part of the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the InterMaths online tool before the late-February cut-off and check the consortium's news page for the official 2027 announcement. Key deadline information: 25 February 2027 (13:00 CET, scholarship round, expected — the 2026 round closed on this date and time).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About InterMaths Consortium (University of L'Aquila)

The InterMaths consortium, anchored at the University of L'Aquila, delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Interdisciplinary Mathematics with European partners and double-degree options.

Official website: https://www.intermaths.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 25 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
